silent_decisions.operation: encode dark skin tone as the positive class of a binary indicator (dark=1, light=0)

misalignments.decision: bin the continuous skin-tone score into three ordinal categories (light/medium/dark) using cutpoints at 0.375 and 0.625
misalignments.claim: players were classified as light skin (mean rating 0.00-0.375) or dark skin (0.75-1.00) for the primary analysis, with medium-skin players (0.375-0.625) excluded to maximize contrast
misalignments.note: code classifies dark as skinTone>0.625, but claim states the dark range is 0.75-1.00

misalignments.decision: bucket free-text playing positions into five keyword-matched categories (Goalkeeper/Defender/Midfielder/Forward/Other)
misalignments.claim: player position was simplified from 12 detailed positions into 4 broad categories
misalignments.note: code buckets positions into five categories (Goalkeeper/Defender/Midfielder/Forward/Other); claim states four broad categories
